This '''skirmish''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] went to Ord Mantell to meet the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arigo]] to give him his cargo drop. When Korr got there, however, Arigo wasn't there and two [[No Scar|other]] [[Scar (criminal)|men]] were there instead. Korr figured out that they were not who was supposed to pick up the cargo, so he would not give it to them. Korr had to fight his way back to his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Fatman]]'', killing both men.<ref name="Deceived" />
